definitions.broken_1y_reversal_q4: Reversal Q4 AND trailing 252-session return <= 0. Closest diagnostic analogue to current NKE/ZTS-type cases.
definitions.entry_gate_episode: entry_ok turns from False to True for a ticker. No arbitrary cooldown or event-spacing rule.
definitions.positive_1y_reversal_q4: Reversal Q4 AND trailing 252-session return > 0. Pullback within positive long-term trend.
definitions.reversal_q4: Top cross-sectional quartile of diagnostic reversal signature using trailing R20, R60, DD252 and 252-session range position.
definitions.weak_60_q25: Bottom cross-sectional quartile of trailing 60-session return on that signal date.

inference.bootstrap: Deterministic moving-block bootstrap on signal-date cluster means.
inference.hac: Newey-West/Bartlett HAC applied to signal-date cluster means.
